title: Programming RNA Trans-Splicing for Versatile Gene Regulation and Complex Cellular Logic Computation.
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦RNA反式剪接的合成生物学基因调控与逻辑计算，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Synthetic biology aims to customize biological systems by programming genetic circuits. However, the scale and complexity of genetic circuits are limited by a shortage of composable, programmable, and orthogonal regulatory parts. Recently, split-intron-enabled trans-splicing riboregulators (SENTRs) have emerged as a promising tool for regulating gene expression at the post-transcriptional level, featuring low leakage expression, wide dynamic range (> 1000-fold), high predictability using machine learning, and orthogonality across multiple intronic components. SENTR's composability with other regulatory modalities, such as split inteins, enables the establishment of a novel split-biomolecule-enabled circuit design paradigm, unleashing the information-processing capacity of a single regulator gene for complex cellular logic computation with up to six inputs. Here, we describe the methods and strategies to implement SENTRs for efficient gene regulation, including computational design, experimental assessment, and statistical analysis of SENTR-based genetic circuits. Validated on ten genes encoding fluorescent proteins, transcription factors, and ncRNAs, this method can be readily utilized to develop SENTRs for diverse applications, such as stringent gene regulation, complex logic computation, and biosensing for intracellular RNAs or physiological biomarkers.
abstract_zh: 合成生物学旨在通过编程基因回路来定制生物系统。然而，基因回路的规模和复杂性受限于可组合、可编程且正交的调控元件短缺。近期，利用分裂内含子实现的跨剪接核糖调节器（SENTRs）已成为在转录后水平调控基因表达的一种有前景的工具，其特点包括低泄漏表达、宽动态范围（>1000倍）、利用机器学习的高预测性，以及多个内含子组件间的正交性。SENTR与其他调控模式（如分裂内含肽）的可组合性，使得建立一种新型的基于分裂生物分子启用的回路设计范式成为可能，从而释放单个调控基因的信息处理能力，用于复杂细胞逻辑计算，最多支持六个输入。在此，我们描述了实现SENTRs以进行高效基因调控的方法和策略，包括基于SENTR的基因回路的计算设计、实验评估和统计分析。该方法已在编码荧光蛋白、转录因子和非编码RNA的十个基因上得到验证，可便捷地用于开发适用于多种应用的SENTRs，如严格基因调控、复杂逻辑计算，以及针对细胞内RNA或生理生物标志物的生物传感。
